🌎 Choose Locations

Choose extra locations for Learn and compatible quizzes. Changing the pool starts a new question. Statehood Timeline always uses U.S. states.

Optional geography packs

Population Showdowns compare the same reference year. Expanded Size Showdowns compare land area. UM is one collective entry, with no common capital or comparable Showdown total.

★ Card Facts

Choose up to four fact groups for the back of your card. All other facts appear in More Facts. City lists and landmarks always live there. Flags and capital stars are always visible where applicable and don’t use a fact slot. Facts that do not apply to a location are omitted.

Primary card facts

⚙ Game settings & offline play

When enabled, apply ready updates at startup and check quietly when you return to the game. Updates found during play wait for Update & Reload. Offline or slow checks never stop the game.

Scoring: 100 points per correct answer, plus a streak bonus that grows by 10 for each consecutive correct answer, up to +100. Wrong answers earn 0 and reset the streak; earned points stay yours.

🎮 Controller controls

Focus this page, then press and release a controller button.

Controls normally appear automatically when a supported controller connects. Fullscreen URLs change the layout only. Keyboard-emulating controller software needs to expose a native gamepad to use these controls.

LB/RB switches Learn, Play and My Progress. In Learn, LT/RT changes cards; X flips, A opens More Facts, and Y switches shape/map. Quiz choices use A/B/X/Y; RT checks or advances, and LT undoes Timeline selections. Menu opens Settings and pauses Sprint; View closes a popup or opens the game picker.

In Settings and popups, D-pad or left stick up/down moves through controls; A toggles sections and checkboxes, opens option choosers or activates buttons. Left/right changes selectors. Right stick up/down scrolls reading panes; LT/RT also scrolls Settings, My Progress and popups. Typed games require a keyboard. Map Quest uses adapted region navigation.

Input diagnostics and button assignments

Buttons: none · Axes: none · Last action: none

For a trigger or shoulder that does not work, release all controls, choose its action, then Assign and press that control. Axis-based triggers are supported. Assignments are saved for this controller on this browser.

Only enable fallback if your device follows the standard layout, then reassign any differing controls. Unmapped layouts are not enabled automatically. Device input readings and assignments stay on this browser. Physical controller compatibility still needs testing on your setup.

Welcome to QuizTrekker – US States!

Discover, learn, and practice your knowledge of the states of the USA!

  • Learn: Explore state shapes, capitals, locations, flags, and fascinating facts.
  • Play: Put your knowledge to the test with a variety of geography games.
  • My Progress: Track the locations you’ve explored and mastered, along with your scores and streaks.
  • Settings ⚙: Choose locations, customize your learning experience, check for updates, and more.
